project_type: Node.js ESM CLI/harness (ATM application-quality + autonomous discovery runner) with a browser dashboard; drives Playwright Chromium and Docker Compose
build_system: npm; no compile/bundle step. Biome 2.5.15 is the linter/formatter (biome.json). Playwright 1.64.0 is the only runtime dep.
test_framework: node:test (built-in). Unit: `node --test test/*.test.js`. Browser: `node --test test/*.browser.js` (real Chromium, no API charges). Postgres/Docker fixture: `node --test test/fixture.postgres.js`.
build_command: npm run lint   (biome check --error-on-warnings .; there is no separate compile step)
verification_instructions: From the worktree root run: `npm run lint` (must be clean, errors on warnings); `npm test` (all unit tests pass); for the benchmark smoke run `node --test test/benchmark-adapter.test.js` with NO OPENAI_API_KEY/ATM_MODEL and Docker stopped. Do NOT run a live model call. Docker/Postgres (test:fixture, test:browser) are NOT required for this change. Baseline before changes: lint clean, 101 unit tests pass.
environment_constraints: Node >=22 (v24). Package is ESM. The benchmark path must run WITHOUT Docker and WITHOUT a model API key. Do NOT attempt live model calls (no API key available). Commit locally only; never push. Worktree cwd: step agents' cwd is the parent workspace, so always use absolute paths and `git -C /Users/shawncoe/Documents/dev/DAD/atm/.worktrees/move2-generic-targets`.
contribution_requirements: ESM imports only. Biome-clean (error-on-warnings). Working/process notes go under git-ignored docs/working/; tracked docs/ is durable product docs only. Do NOT rename DAD's retained `impactgraph` adapter/policy/evidence-key identifiers (documented in README.md and docs/github-gate.md for ledger/finding compatibility). Do NOT weaken any evidence/digest/schema validation in policy.js. Do NOT touch scenarios.js, agent.js, or the deterministic browser.js journeys/runner.js run pipeline beyond threading target/cookie config.
key_patterns: Adapters are plain classes constructed as `(run, options)`. The discovery runner (src/discovery-runner.js executeDiscovery) drives an adapter via: settable `adapter.signal`; provisioning methods snapshot/docker/build/database/deploy(result) each returning {summary} and pushing evidence; `adapter.publicOrigin` (loopback http origin, pathname must be `/`); `adapter.discoveryFixture()` -> array of actor descriptors {id, description, entry?, cookie?}; optional `adapter.source` (path for sourceReader) ; optional `adapter.discoveryReplayFixture()` -> replayFixture object or undefined; `cleanup(result)`. discovery-browser.js degrades gracefully when fixture.replay/inspect are absent. Policy identity today: discoveryPolicy() bakes id 'impactgraph-discovery' + adapter 'impactgraph'; policy.js validatePolicy throws unless adapter === 'impactgraph' (line ~43). The cookie name is hard-coded 'dad_donor_session' in discovery-browser.js bootstrap (~line 106). Benchmark app (src/discovery-benchmark.js benchmarkApplication(fault='healthy')) returns {origin, actors, fixture, judge, close}; actors authenticate by cookie VALUE substring test-a/test-b; in-process loopback http server, NO Docker. scripts/benchmark-discovery.js shows how to write benchmarkSource/benchmarkContract into run.dir/source and build a candidate.
build_command_notes: No compiler. Lint IS the build gate.
